contract.fixed_grid_construction: Construct i%5==0 from all original anchors before feature/label exclusions, then intersect with joint eligible validation dates; never reindex after filtering

contract.invalid_feature_policy: Reject duplicate or out-of-domain dates, wrong feature ID, unregistered statuses, nonfinite values, contradictory engineering-ready/value/status/trace/flag combinations before fitting

contract.decision_time: After signal-date completed close under saved-snapshot assumptions; historical first availability remains uncertified
contract.m3_formula: pg=(kg+20*p0)/(ng+20), exact p0 fallback if ng=0
contract.denominator_definition: Both models use identical matured, selected-feature-valid training rows; group counts are subsets of that common pool
contract.insufficient_training_policy: Below 100 common rows -> both models abstain for the fold; no fallback to an older fold or threshold reduction
contract.training_policy: Expanding window; signal and actual label end strictly before validation start. Fit once and freeze values for each complete fold
contract.validation_policy: Label end <= fold end. M0/M3 same dates and outcomes; keep prior known ex-date and development-end label exclusions
contract.comparability: Refit M0 on the same selected-market-feature pool; do not directly compare with earlier MA-only or price-volume scores on different dates. This does not test a conditional increment above M1 or M2
contract.primary_metric: POOLED all-overlapping mean Brier difference M3-M0; lower is better
contract.fixed_grid: Construct i%5==0 from all 484 original development anchors starting 2023-01-03 before exclusions; intersect with actual scored dates, no phase choice
contract.reporting: Every fold, both groups including empty ones, n/k/zero/negative/p, shared training members, exclusions, paired loss differences, coverage and all fixed bins
contract.development_screen: A descriptive eligibility screen for later design review only: pooled Brier and pooled log loss both strictly lower, fixed-grid Brier no worse, and strictly lower Brier in at least 4 of the 6 folds.
